import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Fix species label variant (chinstrap -> Chinstrap)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Fix island label variant (leading space)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Filter out of range body_mass_g values (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Drop rows with missing sex (can't group by unknown)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
